assumptions: IUPAC complementation, including the ambiguity codes.
limits: Feature strands and coordinates flip with the sequence; qualifiers are not reinterpreted.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: A transform: the same molecule written on the other strand, with nothing inferred.
bio.jane/contract.question: What is the reverse complement of this sequence, with its annotations carried over?

description: Reverse-complement the subject sequence. Emits a NEW record, so downstream nodes (map, digest, gel, ORF) run on the revcomp rather than the original.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

name: reverse_complement
